prompts.title: Adorable Miniature Couple Digital Illustration
prompts.prompt:
Create a heartwarming, ultra-detailed 3D chibi-style couple scene, designed like a miniature handcrafted figurine. Preserve the facial identity of both reference characters with maximum face matching accuracy. Adapt their real facial features naturally into the cute 3D chibi style while keeping both identities clearly recognizable. A cute man and woman sit closely together on a giant human single hand palm, with the man wearing a neatly, white button-up shirt, white trousers, brown loafers, and a wristwatch. He has a, expressive eyes, and a slightly pouty/cute serious expression. The woman sits beside him wearing a white sleeveless crochet/lace dress, white flats, traditional red-and-white bangles, long straight hair, expressive large eyes, and a cute pouty expression. Her arm rests affectionately around his shoulder. Both are looking directly at the camera.
Composition: Centered medium-full miniature couple, both figures fully visible and sitting naturally on the palm, with a large supporting hand beneath them. In the blurred background, include same two tiny chibi couples on opposite sides appearing to playfully argue, with small floating red heart icons.
Style & Details: High-end Pixar-inspired 3D character design, adorable oversized heads, realistic miniature proportions, smooth skin, expressive facial features, detailed fabric and lace textures, polished CGI finish, soft rounded forms, subtle subsurface scattering, realistic hands and fingers, charming storytelling composition.
Background: Warm indoor classroom/studio-like environment with desks, boards, and shelves softly blurred into the background, cinematic bokeh circles and shallow depth of field.
Lighting: Soft warm diffused indoor lighting, gentle highlights on the characters, subtle rim light, natural shadows, cinematic depth, warm pastel color palette.
Camera: Eye-level close-up, slightly low perspective toward the miniature couple, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, f/1.8, cinematic focus, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic 3D rendering, 8K quality, HDR, clean composition, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.
Negative prompt: no multiple human palm, blurry faces, distorted anatomy, malformed hands, extra limbs, low detail, text, watermark, logo, background people, cropped characters.

prompts.title: A Miniature with Chocolate
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic macro portrait of the uploaded handsome person transformed into a tiny, cute chibi-style miniature. Maintain the recognizable facial identity and glasses if present. Give the miniature an oversized semi-realistic head, a very small body, chibi body proportions, and extremely short hands and legs, while keeping the face cute and adorable.
Show the miniature standing on an off-white round tabletop and tightly hugging an extra-oversized red KitKat bar that is significantly taller and wider than his entire body. Both tiny arms should wrap firmly around the chocolate bar as if he refuses to let it go. The KitKat must look like a real wrapped chocolate bar with natural crumpled folds, a torn-open top, and partially eaten chocolate fingers clearly showing crisp wafer layers.
Add realistic chocolate smudges around his mouth, across his fingertips, and on both hands, suggesting he was just eating it. A huge realistic human hand enters from the upper-right corner, gently pinching the back collar of his jacket without covering his face or the KitKat.
Dress him in a dark navy hoodie, white T-shirt, dark slim-fit jeans, and clean matching sneakers. Give him a playful, lovable smile while looking directly at the camera.
Use a tight vertical 4:5 macro composition where the oversized head, miniature, and enormous KitKat dominate the frame. Add a few chocolate crumbs and small melted chocolate drops on the tabletop. Use a soft light-grey bokeh background, soft bright studio lighting, shallow depth of field, outfit texture, and chocolate textures, natural wrapper reflections, and a whimsical premium advertising-photography aesthetic. Avoid adult body proportions, simple background and realistic head.

prompts.title: Pastel Pink Mini-Me
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image only for the female subject’s identity, facial features, hair, and overall likeness. Preserve her apparent age correctly. Do not change her age group, facial maturity, or body proportions.
Create a high-quality studio portrait in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Show the subject seated on a clean seamless white studio floor/background in a soft, charming, visually pleasing pose. She is seated with her knee bent upward and her leg extending forward toward the camera, creating a natural foreground perspective. One hand rests gently against her cheek, while the other arm relaxes naturally across the bent knee or lap. Her body is angled slightly to the side, and her gaze is directed softly sideways with a gentle, warm, natural smile.
Dress her in a soft pastel pink knitted cardigan, a light beige pleated long skirt, white socks, and white Mary Jane shoes. Add a small pink ribbon bow clipped to one side of her hair. Keep the styling neat, soft, elegant, and feminine.
Place a small premium 3D chibi doll version of the same subject beside her near her knee or leg. The doll should clearly resemble the subject’s face, hairstyle, age impression, and outfit colors, wearing the same pink cardigan, beige skirt, white socks, and matching bow. The doll should have a cute polished animated look with large expressive eyes, soft detailed hair, and a cheerful expression. The real subject and the animated doll should look like they are clearly interacting and communicating with each other — as if sharing a sweet moment. Their eye-lines, facial expressions, and body language should feel connected, with the doll looking up at the subject and the subject appearing engaged with the doll in a natural, affectionate, visually clear way.
Use soft diffused high-key studio lighting, subtle natural shadows, clean minimal composition, realistic skin texture, crisp fabric texture, detailed hair strands, and a warm, innocent, premium mood. Keep the main subject dominant, the doll proportionally smaller, and the framing close, balanced, and subject-focused with minimal empty space. No text, watermark, or extra props.

prompts.title: The Perfect Pout
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded female subject as the identity reference and transform her into an extremely cute chibi-style 3D digital illustration while preserving her recognizable facial identity, hairstyle essence, skin tone, eye shape, and overall character likeness. The final character must closely follow the reference style: oversized round head, tiny seated body, big glossy innocent eyes looking slightly upward, sad but adorable pout expression, softly raised worried eyebrows, tiny rounded nose, chubby rosy cheeks, subtle freckles, and a heart-melting cute emotional mood. Keep the expression sad and pouty, but not crying, no tears, no dramatic sadness.
Create a full-body seated pose exactly like the reference: the character sitting cross-legged on the floor, body centered, knees bent outward, small hands gently resting together in front of the feet, shy and innocent posture, head slightly large and tilted naturally. Keep the composition clean and minimal with the full character visible, not cropped, placed in the lower-middle of the frame with plenty of white empty space around her.
Hair should be stylized from the uploaded subject, but rendered in the same soft detailed chibi illustration style with fine individual strands, soft volume, natural shine, and loose wispy hairs around the face. If the reference subject has long hair, convert it into a cute messy high bun or a soft childlike chibi hairstyle while keeping the subject’s identity cues. Outfit should stay simple and close to the reference style: dusty pink oversized t-shirt and mustard-yellow loose cropped pants, soft fabric folds, natural cartoon proportions, no sweater, no leggings, no shoes unless the uploaded subject strongly requires them.
Use a clean pure white background only, with no room, no wall corner, no window, no wooden floor, no furniture, no props, no decorative elements. Add only a very soft contact shadow under the seated body. Rendering style should be premium soft 3D cartoon mixed with polished digital painting, high-quality storybook character illustration, smooth but not plastic, detailed hair strands, soft skin texture, warm gentle lighting, crisp focus, high-resolution finish, adorable emotional charm. No text, no signature, no watermark, no logo. Aspect ratio 4:5.
